                    COMPOSITE ABSTRACT OF VOTES
        FOR NORTH CAROLINA'S NOVEMBER 5, 2024, GENERAL ELECTION


AUTHORITY
"As soon as the State canvass been completed, the State Board shall prepare composite abstracts
of all those ballot items. It shall prepare those composite abstracts in duplicate originals. It shall
retain one of the originals and send the other original to the Secretary of State." N.C.G.S. § 163-
182.6(b).


The North Carolina State Board of Elections, having met pursuant to N.C.G.S. § 163-182.S(c) to
canvass the November 5, 2024, General Election, hereby authenticates the count in every ballot
item in the counties and determines that the votes have been counted and tabulated correctly. The
composite abstract of all the ballot items contained herein shows the number of legal ballots cast
in each county for each office or referendum named, the name of each person or choice voted for,
their party affiliation (where applicable), and the number of votes cast for each person or choice
for the item named.

This 26th day of November, 2024.




 Alan Hirsch, Chair
